title: Approved instruction templates (schemaVersion 1.0.0)
description: Fixed wording for every instruction and notice a rule package can emit. Critical instructions are fixed text; interpreters substitute declared {placeholder} parameters textually and never generate prose, call a model, or evaluate an expression. schemaVersion, ruleVersion, locale, and reviewStatus must match the flow document of the same package.

kind.description: critical wording must never be paraphrased or replaced by generated text; notice is supporting status wording.

params.description: Declared placeholder names. The set must equal exactly the set of {name} placeholders appearing in text; loaders reject any mismatch so an undeclared placeholder can never be rendered.
